rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотри́те, вот наша лужа. Сейчас — плюх!
rows.text: Look, here's our puddle. Now, splash!
rows.heard: Look, here's our puddle. Now splash.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Она не плюхает! Она твёрдая!
rows.text: Oh! No splash! It's hard!
rows.heard: Oh no splash, it's hard.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: The puddle froze! Now it's ice!
rows.heard: The puddle froze, now it's ice.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It shines like glass. And it's so slippery.
rows.heard: It shines like glass, and it's so slippery.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Where's the water? Is it gone?
rows.heard: Where's the water? Is it gone?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Никуда. Вода здесь. Только она стала твёрдой.
rows.text: It's not gone. The water's here. It just got hard.
rows.heard: It's not gone. The water's here. It just got hard.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ночью пришёл мороз. И заморозил лужу.
rows.text: Frost came at night. And froze the puddle.
rows.heard: Frost came at night and froze the puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Smells like cold.
rows.heard: Smells like cold.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Смотри́те, вот наш снеговик! Он стои́т!
rows.text: Look, there's our snowman! He's still standing!
rows.heard: Look, there's our snowman. He's still standing.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Snowy the Second! You didn't melt!
rows.heard: Snowy the second, you didn't melt.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ночью было очень холодно. А в холоде снег не та́ет.
rows.text: It was very cold last night. Snow doesn't melt in the cold.
rows.heard: It was very cold last night. Snow doesn't melt in the cold.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Мороз растопить не может. Мороз — замораживает.
rows.text: Frost can't melt things. Frost freezes them.
rows.heard: Frost can't melt things. Frost freezes them.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Это наша лужа. А теперь это каток!
rows.text: This was our puddle. And now it's a skating rink!
rows.heard: This was our puddle, and now it's a skating rink.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я катаюсь! Я лучше всех катаюсь!
rows.text: I'm skating! I'm the best skater!
rows.heard: I'm skating on the best skater.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oof. It's hard here too.
rows.heard: Oof, it's hard here too.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Can I try too?
rows.heard: Can I try too?

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Whoa! My paws are sliding!
rows.heard: Well, my pods are sliding.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Hold on, Topa! Get up slowly.
rows.heard: Hold on Topa, get up slowly.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Надо ходить маленькими шажками. Как пингвин!
rows.text: Take tiny steps. Like a penguin!
rows.heard: Take tiny steps like a penguin.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А ещё на льду нельзя бегать. Можно упасть.
rows.text: And no running on ice. You can fall.
rows.heard: and no running on ice, you can fall.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: И на речку не ходим. Там лёд бывает тонким.
rows.text: And we don't go on river ice. It can be thin.
rows.heard: And we don't go on river ice. It can be thin.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Knock knock! Puddle, are you home?
rows.heard: Knock knock, puddle are you home?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: It won't open. It's frozen!
rows.heard: It won't open, it's frozen.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А можно сделать лёд самим? До́ма?
rows.text: Can we make ice ourselves? At home?
rows.heard: Can we make ice ourselves at home?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте попробуем! Нужна вода и мороз.
rows.text: Let's try! We need water and frost.
rows.heard: Let's try. We need water and frost.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Here's a bowl. With water.
rows.heard: Here's a bowl with water.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вода мокрая. Её можно налить и вылить.
rows.text: Water is wet. You can pour it in and out.
rows.heard: Water is wet, you can pour it in and out.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вода, стань твёрдой! Раз, два, три!
rows.text: Water, get hard! One, two, three!
rows.heard: Water get hard, one, two, three.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Не получилось. Она меня не слушает.
rows.text: It didn't work. It won't listen to me.
rows.heard: It didn't work. It won't listen to me.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А если подуть? Ффф! Стала твёрдая?
rows.text: What if I blow? Fff! Is it hard now?
rows.heard: What if I blow? FFF, is it hard now?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: No, Ron. You're warm!
rows.heard: No, Ron, you're warm.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: На кухне тепло. Здесь вода не замёрзнет.
rows.text: It's warm in the kitchen. Water won't freeze here.
rows.heard: It's warm in the kitchen, water won't freeze here.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Надо поставить её на мороз. На всю ночь.
rows.text: We have to put it out in the cold. All night.
rows.heard: We have to put it out in the cold, all night.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Night is the coldest time.
rows.heard: Night is the coldest time.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Let me! I'll be careful!
rows.heard: Let me, I'll be careful.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Don't spill it.
rows.heard: Don't spill it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот. Стой тут, миска. Жди мороз.
rows.text: There. Stay here, bowl. Wait for the frost.
rows.heard: There, stay here, bowl. Wait for the frost.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотри́те, вот наш снеговик. Он будет за ней смотреть.
rows.text: Look, there's our snowman. He'll keep an eye on it.
rows.heard: Look, there's our snowman. He'll keep an eye on it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я тоже буду сторожить. Всю ночь!
rows.text: I'll guard it too. All night!
rows.heard: I'll guard it too, all night.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Рон, на у́лице мороз. У тебя нос замёрзнет.
rows.text: Ron, it's frosty outside. Your nose will freeze.
rows.heard: Rollin' it's frosty outside, your nose will freeze.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: My nose is brave.
rows.heard: My nose is brave.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Bless you!
rows.heard: Bless you.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Okay. My nose is cold. Let's go warm up.
rows.heard: Okay, my nose is cold. Let's go warm up.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем. Я скажу слово, а вы — твёрдое оно или мягкое.
rows.text: Let's play a game. I say a word, and you say: is it hard or soft?
rows.heard: Let's play a game. I say a word and you say, is it hard or soft?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Okay!
rows.heard: Okay.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Pillow!
rows.heard: Tyler

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Soft!
rows.heard: Soft.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Stone!
rows.heard: Stone

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Hard!
rows.heard: Hard.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Water in the bowl!
rows.heard: Water in the Bould.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: It splashes!
rows.heard: It splashes.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Snowball!
rows.heard: Snowball.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Cold!
rows.heard: Cold!

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: That's no answer!
rows.heard: That's no answer.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Ice!
rows.heard: Ice.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Hard! And slippery!
rows.heard: Hard and slippery.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: А вода в миске утром, может быть, будет твёрдая.
rows.text: And by morning, the water in the bowl may be hard.
rows.heard: And by morning, the water in the bowl may be hard.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А я пойду спать. Утром узнаем.
rows.text: And I'm off to bed. We'll find out in the morning.
rows.heard: And I'm off to bed. We'll find out in the morning.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Look, here's the bowl!
rows.heard: Look here's the bowl.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The water froze! It's ice now!
rows.heard: The water froze. It's ice now.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Can I touch it? Ooh, so cold!
rows.heard: Can I touch it? It was so cold.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Heavy. And cold!
rows.heard: Heavy and cold.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Turn it over, Ron!
rows.heard: Turn it over Ron.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Nothing comes out! Not a drop!
rows.heard: Nothing comes out, not a drop.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Of course. It's hard. Like a stone.
rows.heard: Of course, it's hard like a stone.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: You can't drink it! Just crunch it!
rows.heard: You can't drink it, just crunch it.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Мы сделали лёд сами! С морозом.
rows.text: We made ice ourselves! With the frost.
rows.heard: We made ice ourselves with the frost.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А что будет, если лёд принести домой?
rows.text: What if we bring the ice inside?
rows.heard: What if we bring the ice inside?

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Where it's warm? Let's go see!
rows.heard: Where it's warm, let's go see.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: There, ice. It's warm here.
rows.heard: There ice, it's warm here.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And I'll warm up with some tea.
rows.heard: and I'll warm up with some tea.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Look, the edge is already wet!
rows.heard: Look, the edge is already wet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Он тает. Скоро снова будет вода.
rows.text: It's melting. Soon it'll be water again.
rows.heard: It's melting! Soon it'll be water again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: I'll wait. Eyes open.
rows.heard: I'll wait, eyes open.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Again.
rows.heard: Again.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Here's the bowl. What's in it?
rows.heard: Here's the bowl. What's in it?

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Water again! I can drink it!
rows.heard: Water again, I can drink it.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: На морозе вода стала твёрдой. А в тепле снова стала водой.
rows.text: In the frost, the water got hard. And in the warmth, it became water again.
rows.heard: In the frost, the water got hard, and in the warmth, it became water again.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вода — как Рон. То бегает, то стои́т.
rows.text: Water is like Ron. Sometimes it runs, sometimes it stops.
rows.heard: Water is like Ron. Sometimes it runs, sometimes it stops.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А снеговик? Он всё ещё на морозе?
rows.text: And the snowman? Is he still out in the cold?
rows.heard: And the snowman is he still out in the cold.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Да. Пока на у́лице холодно, он не раста́ет.
rows.text: Yes. While it's cold outside, he won't melt.
rows.heard: Yes, while it's cold outside, he won't melt.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Мороз делает лёд. А тепло́ делает воду.
rows.text: Frost makes ice. And warmth makes water.
rows.heard: Frost makes ice and warmth makes water.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А медве́ди делают сон. Спокойной ночи.
rows.text: And bears make naps. Good night.
rows.heard: and Bears make naps. Good night.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А кто ночью рисует на окнах?
rows.text: Who draws on the windows at night?
rows.heard: who draws on the windows at night.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Draws? On the windows?
rows.heard: Draws on the windows.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я видел. Белые веточки и звёздочки.
rows.text: I saw it. White twigs and little stars.
rows.heard: I saw it, white twigs and little stars.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Может, это мороз? Он приходит, когда темно.
rows.text: Maybe it's the frost? It comes when it's dark.
rows.heard: Maybe it's the frost. It comes when it's dark.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Or the fir trees came to visit.
rows.heard: or the fir trees came to visit.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Fir trees can't walk, Topa!
rows.heard: Fur trees can't walk topa.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это загадка! Завтра утром посмотрим на окно.
rows.text: What a mystery! Tomorrow morning, we'll check the window.
rows.heard: What a mystery. Tomorrow morning we'll check the window.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу поставить лайк и подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
